title: The Meghalaya Co-operative Societies Act, 2015 (Act No. 11 of 2015)
full_text: The Meghalaya Co-operative Societies Act, 2015 (Act No. 11 of 2015) Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 201511 Act Number: 11 Enactment Date: 2015-10-07 Act Year: 2015 Short Title: The Meghalaya Co-operative Societies Act, 2015 (Act No. 11 of 2015) Long Title: An Act to facilitate the formation and working of Co-operative Societies as accountable, competitive, self reliant, business enterprises based on thrift, self-help and mutual aid and owned, managed and controlled by members for their economic and social betterment and in accordance with the relevant Directive Principles of State Policy of the Constitution of India and for matters connected therewith and incidental thereto.
